content:
maria-t: heads up — saw an ECC correctable spike across pool-east-2 between 08:12-08:20, ~0.9 c/sec on gpu-42 and gpu-43, noise pattern looks bursty not steady
kevin-l: can you paste the hist? rough numbers?
maria-t: p50=0.1, p95=0.85, 5m-avg=0.65, 3 hosts affected but same rack
samir: Xid lines from kernel show repeated "Xid 59" on gpu-43, driver retrys
oliver: this isn't a full failure yet, but user-visible latency increased on some small batches
infra-bot: alert: ECC_CORRECTABLE spike detected (rule: correctables_rate>0.5 for 5m) — auto-signal created #INC-5142
maria-t: propose we stop draining aggressively based on raw counts. suggest: aggregate per-card noise rate normalized by p95 load, and bias eviction away from heavy-tenant hosts
kevin-l: +1. how do you quantify bias? prefer evicting hosts with lower recent customer-impact score?
maria-t: idea: score = 0.7*noise_rate_norm + 0.3*card_age + tenant_impact_penalty. pick top-scoring cards for soft-evac first
samir: we should also add a hysteresis window: require sustained rate >0.6 for 10m OR 3 distinct error types in 1h
oliver: sounds reasonable. also add a safe-fallback: if soft-evac fails, move to warm-pool allocation before hard drain
maria-t: playbook draft:
- tag noisy cards with `ecc-noise:<score>`
- run `infra-cli drain --host <host> --mode soft --reason ecc-noise --annotation "score=<s>"`
- if remaining correctables rise >20% on same rack, escalate to replace
kevin-l: example command we used earlier:
```
infra-cli evict --host gpu-43 --soft --reason "ecc-noise" --fallback warm-pool
```
samir: we'll run a canary for 48h on pool-east-2 with biasing enabled, TTL=24h for tags
maria-t: i'll run a simulation tonight to compute false-positive rate using last 90d of telemetry and post results here tomorrow :eyes:
infra-bot: note: rollout plan created in infra/eviction-biasing (PR #822) — request review from @kevin-l @maria-t
oliver: minor ask — add an override to force-drain for critical infra tests
maria-t: noted. thanks all :thumbsup:
